runtime_prerequisites.order: Matching backend and frontend in one existing Docker deployment; additive startup indexes before collector task.

runtime_prerequisites.reports: Existing configured MongoDB must support snapshot transactions and the current unsharded distinct query. No inconsistent-read fallback; unsupported snapshots fail closed with 503.
runtime_prerequisites.provider_shell: Free staging compute has no Shell/SSH. No upgrade/settings changes. Ordinary hosted report generation is required feature evidence.
runtime_prerequisites.local_replica: New owned loopback MongoDB8.0.28 process/db/log, publisher checksum verified; distinct from hosted support.
